summary.note: Nightly streams with a transcript, Sep 2025 to Sep 2026. A topic counts for a stream when its keywords come up 3 or more times. Question counts are streams where the matching phrase came up at least once.
summary.topicRule: A topic counts for a stream when its keywords appear 3 or more times.
